image_prompt.text: A square cave room about 40 studs wide with a flat slate floor and jagged dark slate-gray rocky walls and ceiling built from rough overlapping rock blocks, matching the style of the underground mine corridor it opens off
An open entrance on the front framed in warm reddish-brown timber: two vertical wood pillars, a horizontal crossbeam across the top, and diagonal corner braces
A soft yellow lantern hanging from the centre of the entrance crossbeam, lighting the dark atmospheric mine interior
A grid of low dark slate pedestals set out across the room floor, each one a stand for a displayed gem

layout_placement.text: Each pedestal in the grid is a placement station in the mining loop — the player walks up and deposits a mined gem onto it

notes: Simulation on the prompt's own words: a mining game, and specifically a player's mine plot. The plot is a single enclosed side chamber rather than an open lot, but it is still one player's own non-overlapping ground, so plot-isolated is the shape and it routes P0.

Mining & Extraction was the closest preset by name and was rejected. It builds world-underground (multi-level surface-and-underground layers, P2 + P3) with resource-shared, collectible-nodes and path-road-vehicle; this prompt is one single-level personal chamber with no shared field, no ore veins and no hauling roads, so the shape and every option would have been dropped. Nothing recognisable of the preset would survive, hence preset null.

The chamber is roofed and fully enclosed, so the play volume is occluded from above — worth a CHECK look at segmentation. Nothing inside the room overhangs anything else and the floor is flat, so no P2 was taken and the route stays P0.

The prompt asks for exposed attributes (room size, rock color, wood color, pedestal count, lantern brightness). These are build parameters rather than geometry or placed volumes, so no option and neither list can carry them; recorded here so they are not lost. No pedestal count was stated, so no count field was emitted.
The prompt says the room is walkable for a Roblox character, so this is an ordinary traversable space and SET does not apply.

would have asked: Sounds like a personal player mine plot: your own square rock-walled chamber about 40 studs across, opening off the main corridor through a timbered frame with a lantern over it, and a grid of slate pedestals inside to set your gems on. It builds on the standard pipeline with no extra cost. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: confirm the pedestal grid is the only station in the plot. The genre's Core options — an upgrades bazaar, progression circulation, purchase gates and stat training stations — were all left out because the prompt names none of them, and this is only a single room.
would have asked: is the mine corridor outside the entrance part of this build, or does the room just need to match its style? It was read as style-matching only, so no corridor geometry was emitted.
